2026_01_NYJ_TEN.headline: New York’s backfield health and Tennessee’s front shape a game built around staying on schedule
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.paragraph1: Breece Hall says he feels fresh after a cautious return from a groin strain, giving New York a chance to protect its passing game with efficient early-down runs and controlled tempo. Tennessee enters with its own defensive availability questions, including Cedric Gray’s concussion status, and will want to keep the Jets in longer-yardage situations. The Titans’ offense also needs to avoid short fields against an aggressive New York defense. This game is likely to be decided by rushing efficiency, third-down distance and turnover avoidance.
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.model_rationale: New York can reduce offensive volatility by leaning on Hall, while Tennessee needs its front to win early downs and prevent the Jets from dictating manageable situations.
